title: Savannah River Tank 3 joins a seven-tank preliminary waste-removal concurrence cohort
publisher: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Environmental Management
summary: DOE reports regulator concurrence on preliminary cease waste removal for Tank 3, the seventh old-style tank to reach PCWR since 2024 and one of seven completed 7 to 27 months ahead of Federal Facility Agreement deadlines. Denominator: Seven named old-style SRS tanks receiving PCWR concurrence since 2024 under the Federal Facility Agreement process.
key_findings: Finding: DOE reports regulator concurrence on preliminary cease waste removal for Tank 3, the seventh old-style tank to reach PCWR since 2024 and one of seven completed 7 to 27 months ahead of Federal Facility Agreement deadlines.
